text: All would have gone smoothly had the king's head cook not received a fresh shipment of white rock salt from the coastal pans of the river mouth.
The sacks were piled high in the courtyard just below the guest quarters.
As the evening breeze carried the sharp, delicious aroma of mineral salt upstairs, Fari's nostrils began to twitch.
In the royal salon, her eyes dilated with wild craving.
One by one, the refined princesses began pacing the rugs with sudden, choppy steps, sniffing the air with uncontrollable enthusiasm.
